title: Rickover tells Townsend Brown the Navy is already on it

tellings.quote: hman rickover goes oh uh don't waste your time we're already on it like we know all about this

plain: At some point between the 1950s and early 1960s, the researcher Thomas Townsend Brown brought his work to Hyman Rickover, a senior US Navy figure, and Rickover told him not to bother. Michels tells it himself, without naming a source, and quotes Rickover as saying, in effect, "don't waste your time, we're already on it, we know all about this." If true, it would mean the Navy was already quietly working on whatever Brown was offering.
